THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS
, THIS DAY,
G.NARENDAR J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
JUDGMENT Heard the learned counsel for the appellant.

2. It is the case of the appellant that in respect of similarly placed land losers, acquiring body /
beneficiary has been pleased to grant interest at higher rate resulting in higher compensation to the other land losers.
3. On a query, learned counsel for the appellant would fairly admit that it is a consent award.
The terms of the consent being the settlement between the parties, it would be inappropriate to the Court to dictate the terms of contract.
In that view of the matter, we are of the opinion that it would not be appropriate to the Court to impose the terms and conditions.

Be that as it may, in view of the fact that the appellants are also similarly situated as other land losers who have been granted higher rate of interest, we deem it appropriate to permit the appellant to make a representation to the concerned authority and if such a representation is made to the concerned / competent authority, the same shall be considered and disposed of within four months and strictly in accordance with law.
